title: torreya grandis var. yunnanensis
intro: Torreya grandis var. yunnanensis, commonly known as Yunnan torreya, is a variety of the Torreya grandis plant, a species of conifer in the family Podocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is primarily used to treat respiratory issues. The health benefits of Torreya grandis var. yunnanensis include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as bronchodilation and antimicrobial effects.
